2607.28292.title: CACHE-UK: A Stability-Aware Memory Editor for Sequentially Updated Quantized LLMs in Finance
2607.28292.paper_summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) deployed in dynamic financial environments face a critical challenge: maintaining factual accuracy as market conditions, regulations, and corporate facts change continuously. While 4-bit quantization enables efficient deployment, it severely limits the viability of sequential memory editing: existing methods undergo catastrophic performance degradation under this "quantization stability crisis." We introduce CACHE-UK (Contextual Adaptive Continual Hybrid Editor for UK Finance), a stability-aware memory editing framework specifically designed for domain-specific, quantized LLMs. CACHE-UK integrates three components: a rank-1 LoRA perturbation mechanism that confines edits to the low-rank adapter subspace, a financial domain prioritization module for content-adaptive edit strength, and a closed-loop Stability Controller that tracks "degradation debt" to prevent catastrophic forgetting across sequential updates. Evaluated on a 4-bit quantized OpenLLaMA-3B model with a curated UK financial corpus of 88,021 documents, CACHE-UK reduces knowledge degradation by 11-17% relative to adapted baselines under identical 4-bit constraints -- its most robust effect -- while attaining the highest test success (generalization) rate observed in our setting (28%, a 6 percentage point improvement over the strongest adapted baseline). These results indicate that stability-aware editing can improve factual maintenance in resource-constrained financial LLM deployments, though absolute generalization rates remain low.
2607.28292.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLMs）在動態金融環境中面臨一個關鍵挑戰：隨著市場條件、法規和企業事實不斷變化，保持事實準確性。雖然4位元量化使得高效部署成為可能，但它嚴重限制了序列記憶編輯的可行性：現有方法在這種「量化穩定性危機」下會遭遇災難性的性能下降。我們介紹了CACHE-UK（Contextual Adaptive Continual Hybrid Editor for UK Finance），這是一個專為特定領域的量化LLMs設計的穩定性意識記憶編輯框架。CACHE-UK整合了三個組件：一個將編輯限制在低秩適配器子空間的rank-1 LoRA擾動機制、一個用於內容自適應編輯強度的金融領域優先模塊，以及一個跟踪「退化債務」以防止在序列更新中災難性遺忘的閉環穩定性控制器。在對具有88,021份文件的精選英國金融語料庫進行評估的4位元量化OpenLLaMA-3B模型上，CACHE-UK相對於在相同4位元限制下的適應基準減少了11-17%的知識退化——其最強的效果——同時在我們的設置中達到了最高的測試成功（泛化）率（28%，比最強的適應基準提高了6個百分點）。這些結果表明，具備穩定性意識的編輯可以改善資源受限的金融LLM部署中的事實維護，儘管絕對的泛化率仍然較低。
2607.28292.author: Anubhav Lakra et.al.
